# app/ — Next.js App Router entry

*Generated by index-knowledge · commit 917d399 · branch main. See ../AGENTS.md for project-wide conventions.*

## OVERVIEW
The whole client app. `page.tsx` (816 lines) is `HomeContent` — all state, all data fetching, and URL⇄state sync. `layout.tsx` = root layout (Rubik font) + pre-paint mono script. `globals.css` = Tailwind import + MT compat shims + mono/invert filter rules + splash styles.

## WHERE TO LOOK
| Task | Location |
|------|----------|
| Add/rename a URL param | `page.tsx` param-read effect (~L521) AND URL-sync effect (~L577) — both, plus `homeassistant/run.sh` add_param |
| OpenMeteo fetch (default) | `getWeather` (~L218) |
| OpenWeatherMap fetch | `getCurrent` (~L282) + `getForecast` (~L331) |
| Location resolution | `getReverseLocation` latlon (~L382), `getZipcodeLocation` (~L434), `getZipCity` USPS (~L485) |

| Mono class toggling | mono `useEffect` (~L715) toggles `html.mono` / `html.invert` |
| Avoid mono flash pre-paint | `layout.tsx` inline `<script>` |

## CACHE CONTRACTS (localStorage)
- `current`+`forecast` (OpenMeteo): reused if <2min OR lat/lon match to 6dp, AND source matches.
- `current` (OWM): <5min. `forecast` (OWM): <1hr.
- `tempSensor` (AWN): <1min. `location`: keyed by `source` ('latlon'|'zipcode'). `zipCity:<zip>`: permanent (offline kiosks).
- `version`: written by the `window.fetch` monkey-patch (~L47) from the `x-version` response header (set in `middleware.ts`) — force-reloads the page on change to auto-update kiosks.

## GOTCHAS
- **URL sync is split across two effects** — read and write are separate; new params need both.
- `checkIsNight` is disabled while spoofing; HA Sun2 (`haSunrise/haSunset`) overrides the provider's sun. Spoof fixtures use stale 2024 sunrise/sunset, so spoofed weather can read as night.
- `getCurrent` has a stray `alert(JSON.stringify(e))` (~L303) instead of `addAlert` — a real modal; avoid triggering it under browser automation.
- `useSearchParams()` forces the `<Suspense>` wrapper in `Home()` — don't remove it.
- Backgrounds key off OWM `current.id` even when `weatherSource=OpenMeteo` (codes mapped in `lib/utils.ts`).
